en: Philippians 3

p.src: 1  Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

ja: じことをあなたがたに
には煩わしいことではなく、あなたがたを守ることになります。
en: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
u.src: 1  Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

p.src: 2  Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

en: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
u.src: 2  Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

p.src: 3  For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

ja: し、キリスト・イエスにあって
en: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
u.src: 3  For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

p.src: 4  though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

ja: る根拠もあります。ほかのだれかが
en: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
u.src: 4  though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

p.src: 5  circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

ja: についてはファリサイ人、
en: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
u.src: 5  circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

p.src: 6  concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

en: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
u.src: 6  concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

p.src: 7  However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

ja: と数えるようになりました。
en: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
u.src: 7  However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

p.src: 8  Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

ja: ることの比類ない尊さのゆえに、
と数えています。キリストのためにすべてを
なしています。それは、私がキリストを
en: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
u.src: 8  Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

p.src: 9  and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

ja: キリストのうちにある
められるためです。私が持つ
ではなく、キリストへの
en: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,
u.src: 9  and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

p.src: 10  that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

ja: しみにあずかり、キリストの
と同じ姿にされたいのです。
en: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
u.src: 10  that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

p.src: 11  if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

ja: したいと願っています。
en: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
u.src: 11  if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

p.src: 12  Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

ja: な者にされたわけでもありません。しかし、キリスト・イエスに捕らえられた
らえようとして、ひたすら
en: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
u.src: 12  Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

zh: 3:12 所以得着我的：或譯所要我得的

p.src: 13  Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

ja: らえたとは考えていません。ただ
en: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
u.src: 13  Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

p.src: 14  I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

ja: キリスト・イエスにあって
に向かって進んでいます。
en: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
u.src: 14  I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

p.src: 15  Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

ja: は皆、このように考えましょう。もし
かについて違う考えを持っているなら、そのことも神があなたがたに明らかにしてくださいます。
en: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
u.src: 15  Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

p.src: 16  Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

ja: み、同じ思いを保ちましょう。
en: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
u.src: 16  Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

p.src: 17  Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

en: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
u.src: 17  Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

p.src: 18  For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

ja: として歩んでいるからです。私は彼らのことを何度もあなたがたに話し、今も涙を流しながら話しています。
en: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
u.src: 18  For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

p.src: 19  whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

ja: のことばかり考えています。
en: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
u.src: 19  whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

p.src: 20  For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

ja: にあります。私たちはそこから
en: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
u.src: 20  For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

p.src: 21  who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

en: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
u.src: 21  who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
